Title: Azure Container Storage is now available with Azure Linux container host

Body.Content:
Azure Container Storage in preview, provides highly scalable, cost-effective volumes for production-scale stateful container applications seamlessly via Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) CLI. You can now leverage Azure Container Storage with AKS clusters or nodepools using Azure Linux container host. To achieve this, you can simply create a new managed Kubernetes cluster by selecting the OS SKU as Azure Linux and enabling Azure Container Storage, directly as part of the AKS cluster create or update CLI experience.

To learn more, read the documentation, blog, and watch the video
